Price Plans
Existing Customers
How to Switch
Log out
Smart Meter
Smart Meters are the next generation of electricity meters being rolled out across Ireland. If you submit your own readings or a meter reader calls to your house to take your meter read, then you do not have a Smart Meter. If you are unsure if you have had a smart meter installed, don’t worry, once you input your MPRN we will advise you if you are able to avail of a smart price plan.
Unit Rate discount
16% discount is applied to electricity unit prices.
First Year Cost
The First Year Cost represents the Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) with unit rate discount and any welcome bonus applied.
Advanced Electricity insights
Projected usage charts to keep your costs on track, similar homes analysis to guide you to reduce energy usage, personalised energy saving tips to help you use less, monthly electricity bill on a date of your choice, no more estimated electricity bills or bill surprises.
Free Electricity
Choose either Saturday or Sunday for free electricity, applied to your usage between 08:00 - 23:00 on that day.

Our website uses cookies and other similar technologies which are strictly necessary for it to function. These are enabled by default and cannot be disabled.
We would also like to use additional cookies to analyse how you use our website, and to deliver personalised content and advertising. You can enable these additional cookies by selecting “Save Settings” or disable them by selecting “Reject All”.
You can learn more about and enable specific cookie categories by clicking on each of the different category headings. If you have opted to enable some but not all cookies, be sure to select “Save Settings” before exiting “Cookie Settings”.
Please note, disabling some or all additional cookie categories may impact your experience of our website and the services we are able to offer you.
You can adjust your cookie preferences at any time via “Cookie Settings” linked below within our website’s footer.
Find more information by visiting the cookie policy on our website.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.
Cookies Details
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
Off
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
Off
Functional cookies allow this website to remember choices you make and any customisations you make to website pages during your visit and provide enhanced, more personal features. For instance, these cookies can be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts and other parts of web pages that you can have changed. They may also be used to provide services you have asked for such as watching a video or commenting on a blog. The information these cookies collect cannot track your browsing activity on other websites. More information about such cookies can be found in the relevant third-party website.
Cookies Details
Targeting & Advertising Cookies
Targeting & Advertising Cookies
Off
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Price Plans

How to Switch
Log out
Smart Meter
Smart Meters are the next generation of electricity meters being rolled out across Ireland. If you submit your own readings or a meter reader calls to your house to take your meter read, then you do not have a Smart Meter. If you are unsure if you have had a smart meter installed, don’t worry, once you input your MPRN we will advise you if you are able to avail of a smart price plan.
Unit Rate discount
The discount is applied to your electricity and gas unit prices.
First Year Cost
The First Year Cost represents the Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) after the welcome bonus is applied.
Advanced Electricity insights
Projected usage charts to keep your costs on track, similar homes analysis to guide you to reduce energy usage, personalised energy saving tips to help you use less, monthly electricity bill on a date of your choice, no more estimated electricity bills or bill surprises.
Free Electricity
Choose either Saturday or Sunday for free electricity, applied to your usage between 08:00 - 23:00 on that day.

Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.

Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
Off
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Functional cookies allow this website to remember choices you make and any customisations you make to website pages during your visit and provide enhanced, more personal features. For instance, these cookies can be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts and other parts of web pages that you can have changed. They may also be used to provide services you have asked for such as watching a video or commenting on a blog. The information these cookies collect cannot track your browsing activity on other websites. More information about such cookies can be found in the relevant third-party website.

<script>
    let roiModal, niModal, geoLocationResponse;
    window.onload = () => {
        checkLocation();
    }
    const checkLocation = () => {
        if (optanonCategoryEnabled("OptanonConsent", "C0004")) {
            roiModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('roiModal'), options);
            niModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('niModal'), options);
            //If both cookies are undefined execute look up
            if (typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined");
            {
                GetToken().then(data => {
                    geoLocationResponse = data;
                    var result = geoLocationResponse.match(/GB/) || geoLocationResponse.match(/IE/);
                    var url = location.href;

                    if (url.indexOf(".com") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "IE") {
                        delCookie('NI');
                        roiModal.show();

                    } else if (url.indexOf(".ie") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "GB") {
                        delCookie('ROI');
                        niModal.show();
                    }
                    else if (result != "IE" && result != "GB") {
                        setCookie('outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt', 1, 30);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    const stayInSiteLocation = (loc) => {
        let msg = "NI";
        if (loc == "ROI") msg = "ROI";
        setCookie(msg + '-customer-region-prompt', 1, 180);
        loc == "ROI" ? roiModal.hide() : niModal.hide();
    }
    async function GetToken() {
    let myPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        fetch('/api/regional-prompt-token')
            .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Network response was not ok ' + response.statusText);
                }
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                resolve(data.Token);
            })
            .catch(error => {
            });
        });
        return await myPromise;
    }
</script>

            return false;

<script>
    let roiModal, niModal, geoLocationResponse;
    window.onload = () => {
        checkLocation();
    }
    const checkLocation = () => {
        if (optanonCategoryEnabled("OptanonConsent", "C0004")) {
            roiModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('roiModal'), options);
            niModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('niModal'), options);
            //If both cookies are undefined execute look up
            if (typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined");
            {
                GetToken().then(data => {
                    geoLocationResponse = data;
                    var result = geoLocationResponse.match(/GB/) || geoLocationResponse.match(/IE/);
                    var url = location.href;

                    if (url.indexOf(".com") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "IE") {
                        delCookie('NI');
                        roiModal.show();

                    } else if (url.indexOf(".ie") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "GB") {
                        delCookie('ROI');
                        niModal.show();
                    }
                    else if (result != "IE" && result != "GB") {
                        setCookie('outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt', 1, 30);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    const stayInSiteLocation = (loc) => {
        let msg = "NI";
        if (loc == "ROI") msg = "ROI";
        setCookie(msg + '-customer-region-prompt', 1, 180);
        loc == "ROI" ? roiModal.hide() : niModal.hide();
    }
    async function GetToken() {
    let myPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        fetch('/api/regional-prompt-token')
            .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Network response was not ok ' + response.statusText);
                }
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                resolve(data.Token);
            })
            .catch(error => {
            });
        });
        return await myPromise;
    }
</script>

Microgeneration is here
Electric Ireland is supporting customers on their low-carbon journey with a current Microgen export rate of 19.5c per kWh.
Microgeneration: Power to the People
To view this content, please enable cookies.
View Cookie Settings
Learn more about Microgeneration
What is microgeneration?
Microgeneration is the generation of green electricity from renewable technologies, such as solar panels, micro-wind, micro-hydro and micro-renewable combined heat and power (CHP).
The Government Microgeneration Support Scheme is now available so that those with a registered microgeneration device can sell any excess electricity back to Ireland’s electricity grid. This will help households reduce their carbon footprint and save money.
What is the Microgeneration Scheme?
The Government Microgeneration Support Scheme allows households with a registered microgeneration device to sell any excess electricity back to Ireland’s electricity grid. This payment is called a Clean Export Guarantee (CEG).
Electric Ireland customers who own a micro-generator such as solar PV, micro-wind, micro-hydro, or renewable micro-CHP are eligible for this scheme. You must have an export grid connection, which is typically organised by the installer on installation or can be organised through ESB Networks.
How can I avail of microgeneration?
Most Electric Ireland microgenerators have solar PV installed on their roof. Your solar PV installer would have registered an NC6 form on your behalf to ESB Networks. This form provides us with the information we need to set you up.
Learn more about solar
Is there a grant for solar PV ?
Electric Ireland customers can avail of up to €1,800 from an SEAI grant towards the cost of installing solar PV in your home.
Learn more about grants
Electric Ireland is supporting customers on their low-carbon journey
Duncan Stewart
Microgeneration is here and Electric Ireland is supporting customers on their low-carbon journey. Architect and environmentalist Duncan Stewart speaks to Electric Ireland about the small changes we can all make that will have a big impact.
Learn more
Aoife Gallagher
Aoife Gallagher is Electric Ireland’s Microgeneration Product Manager, and as an energy engineer is best-placed to answer some of your frequently asked questions around microgeneration.
Learn  more
Frequently asked questions
What rate will I be paid?
Electric Ireland’s current Microgen Export rate is 19.5c per kWh. This rate is variable and subject to change. We estimate that customer export payments will range between €50-€300 per year, depending on the size and type of your microgeneration system (a typical installation of 10 panels would be about €150 per year).
When will my payment start?
On receipt of the NC6 form, ESB Networks will set up your export account.
Electric Ireland will receive your export data from ESB Networks, and you will then receive a microgeneration credit on each bill thereafter in line with your billing cycle.
Do I need a smart meter to avail of microgeneration?
In line with guidelines provided by CRU (Commission for Regulation of Utilities), a smart meter is required to avail of The Microgeneration Support Scheme. To date, as part of the national meter upgrade programme, ESB Networks have been replacing standard 24-hour electricity meters with smart meters. From September 2023, ESB Networks will begin replacing day/night meters with smart meters.
Smart meters can measure the profile of demand at your home and thereby allow you to maximise your self-consumption. Smart meters can also measure the export of microgeneration installations to facilitate access to remuneration for residual electricity exported to the grid.
If you have a microgenerator installed, such as solar PV, your installer will submit the required NC6 connection form to ESB Networks on your behalf. This form will inform us at Electric Ireland that you have a registered microgeneration device and
ESB Networks
will install a smart meter for you if you do not already have one.
If, for technical reasons, you cannot have a smart meter installed in your home, Electric Ireland will contact you to discuss.
If you choose to decline a smart meter, unfortunately you will not be eligible to avail of The Microgeneration Support Scheme, this is in line with CRU guidelines. For more information on the benefits of smart meters, visit our
smart meters FAQs
.
How does microgeneration work?
Microgenerators generate clean, renewable energy to meet some or all of the electricity demands of a household or business. When coupled with a diverter, this renewable energy can heat a water tank.
The Government Microgeneration Support Scheme is now available so that those with a registered microgeneration device can sell any excess electricity back to Ireland’s electricity grid.
This will help households reduce their carbon footprint and save money.
Who is eligible for the Microgeneration Support Scheme?
Electric Ireland customers that have a microgenerator installed such as solar PV, micro-wind, micro-hydro or renewable micro-CHP.
You must have notified ESB Networks via an NC6 form of your export grid connection.
Eligible customers will need a smart meter installed to be paid for Microgeneration export. Where customers eligible customer have not yet been offered a Smart meter, ESB Networks will endeavour to install a smart meter within four months of a valid
NC6 form
being processed by ESB Networks.
If you're not eligible to have a smart meter installed, then you'll be paid a deemed export calculation.
What is the Clean Export Guarantee?
The Clean Export Guarantee (CEG) is the payment households will receive when they sell their excess electricity back to the national grid.
I'm on a day/night tariff, can I avail of microgeneration?
From September 2023, ESB Networks will begin replacing day/night meters with smart meters.
Smart meters can measure the profile of demand at your home and thereby allow you to maximise your self-consumption. Smart meters can also measure the export of microgeneration installations to facilitate access to remuneration for residual electricity exported to the grid.
If you have a microgenerator installed, such as solar PV, your installer will submit the required NC6 connection form to ESB Networks on your behalf. This form will let us at Electric Ireland know that you have a registered microgeneration device and
ESB Networks
will install a smart meter for you.
If you are an existing Microgeneration customer with a day/night meter, you will continue to receive your deemed estimate Microgen credit on your bill until your smart meter is installed.
If you currently have a day/night meter and become a microgeneration customer after the 11th of September 2023, your microgeneration credit will begin after your smart meter is installed.
If, for technical reasons, you cannot have a smart meter installed in your home, Electric Ireland will contact you to discuss.
If you choose to decline a smart meter, unfortunately you will not be eligible to avail of The Microgeneration Support Scheme after the 11th of September 2023, meaning your microgeneration credits will cease at this time, this is in line with CRU guidelines. For more information on the benefits of smart meters, visit our
smart meters FAQs
.
I am not an Electric Ireland customer, can I still avail of the Microgeneration Scheme?
Only Electric Ireland customers who meet the criteria above are eligible for the Microgeneration Scheme through Electric Ireland.
Sign up to Electric Ireland
.
What is solar PV?
Solar PV panels use the sun's energy to convert daylight into renewable energy. The electricity is then consumed within the home, reducing your need to buy energy from a supplier. When a Solar PV system produces more energy than a home needs, the extra energy can go to your immersion heater. Solar PV is not to be confused with
Solar Thermal - while Solar Thermal heats water only, Solar PV gives you free electricity and hot water.
Most customers install solar PV on their roof, however they can be installed anywhere on your property where there is sufficient open space and good sun exposure.
Electric Ireland can provide customers with solar PV through our preferred partners, NRG Panel. Our specialist teams will help you apply for
solar PV grants
from the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland (SEAI).
What happens if I switch to another electricity provider after registering for microgeneration with Electric Ireland?
At the end of this year you will be paid by Electric Ireland for the period up to switching to another supplier and your new supplier will advise on how they will make the payment for the next period.
I have solar PV installed but I don’t know the status of my NC6 or NC5 form.
It’s likely that your PV installer submitted an NC6 or NC5 form on your behalf. Once the form is processed we are made aware that you have a microgeneration system at your property. We recently contacted all of our customers who we know to have microgeneration. If you did not hear from us it's possible that an NC5 or NC6 form has not been submitted for your microgenerator and you will need to contact your installer or ESB Networks for advice.
Where can I get an NC6 form?
The NC6 form and associated information is available on
ESB Networks website.
How does the microgeneration payment work?
Your first payment will be a backdated payment made in the form of a credit on your electricity bill at the end of 2022. Thereafter a credit will be applied on each bill reflecting your microgeneration export in that period.
Can I see how much electricity I am exporting to the grid?
The number of units that you have exported will be displayed on your Electric Ireland bill in line with your billing cycle.
Also, if you have a Smart Meter, you can check this by pressing the left blue button on your smart meter 7 times until you see A- in the top right-hand side of the screen. This will display the quantity of units of electricity you have exported.
The insights in my online account don’t look right?
Appliance itemisation in your online account uses import data from the grid to determine estimated usage. Because you generate your own electricity, these insights and the corresponding advice may not represent actual appliance usage. The total kWh’s you have imported and your billed amount are accurate. Although export data is not shown in your online account, you may be able to view yours by creating a
ESB Networks Online Customer Account
.

<div class="content-block">
    <h2 style="text-align: center">Learn more about Microgeneration</h2>
</div><div class="row" data-sf-element="Row">
    <div id="Contentplaceholder1_C018_Col00" class="sf_colsIn col-sm" data-sf-element="Column 1" data-placeholder-label="Column 1">

<div class="spot mid-blue">
    <div class="spot-text-content">
        <h3>What is microgeneration?</h3>
        <p>Microgeneration is the generation of green electricity from renewable technologies, such as solar panels, micro-wind, micro-hydro and micro-renewable combined heat and power (CHP).<br><br>The Government Microgeneration Support Scheme is now available so that those with a registered microgeneration device can sell any excess electricity back to Ireland’s electricity grid. This will help households reduce their carbon footprint and save money.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="image-container">
    <img src="https://prd-cdn.electricireland.ie/media/images/default-source/landing-pages/microgeneration/microgen-spotlight_1.jpg?sfvrsn=e8967fc4_3" alt="" class="lazyload">
    </div>
</div>


    </div>
    <div id="Contentplaceholder1_C018_Col01" class="sf_colsIn col-sm" data-sf-element="Column 2" data-placeholder-label="Column 2">

<div class="spot core-blue">
    <div class="spot-text-content">
        <h3>What is the Microgeneration Scheme?</h3>
        <p>The Government Microgeneration Support Scheme allows households with a registered microgeneration device to sell any excess electricity back to Ireland’s electricity grid. This payment is called a Clean Export Guarantee (CEG).<br><br>Electric Ireland customers who own a micro-generator such as solar PV, micro-wind, micro-hydro, or renewable micro-CHP are eligible for this scheme. You must have an export grid connection, which is typically organised by the installer on installation or can be organised through ESB Networks.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="image-container">
    <img src="https://prd-cdn.electricireland.ie/media/images/default-source/landing-pages/microgeneration/microgen-spotlight_2.jpg?sfvrsn=80331f6b_3" alt="" class="lazyload">
    </div>
</div>


    </div>
</div>
<div class="row" data-sf-element="Row">
    <div id="Contentplaceholder1_C022_Col00" class="sf_colsIn col-sm" data-sf-element="Column 1" data-placeholder-label="Column 1">

<div class="spot core-blue">
    <div class="spot-text-content">
        <h3>How can I avail of microgeneration?</h3>
        <p>Most Electric Ireland microgenerators have solar PV installed on their roof. Your solar PV installer would have registered an NC6 form on your behalf to ESB Networks. This form provides us with the information we need to set you up.</p>
                <a class="btn btn-primary btn-medium" href="/residential/products/solar-pv-for-homes" aria-label="Learn more about solar about How can I avail of microgeneration?">
                    Learn more about solar
                </a>
    </div>
    <div class="image-container">
    <img src="https://prd-cdn.electricireland.ie/media/images/default-source/landing-pages/microgeneration/how-can-i-avail-of-microgen.jpg?sfvrsn=6d390fc2_1" alt="" class="lazyload">
    </div>
</div>


    </div>
    <div id="Contentplaceholder1_C022_Col01" class="sf_colsIn col-sm" data-sf-element="Column 2" data-placeholder-label="Column 2">

<div class="spot elec-yellow">
    <div class="spot-text-content">
        <h3>Is there a grant for solar PV ?</h3>
        <p>Electric Ireland customers can avail of up to €1,800 from an SEAI grant towards the cost of installing solar PV in your home.</p>
                <a class="btn btn-primary btn-medium" href="https://www.seai.ie/grants/home-energy-grants/solar-electricity-grant/" aria-label="Learn more about grants - Open link in new tab or window">
                    Learn more about grants

<div class="spot elec-green">
    <div class="spot-text-content">
        <h3>Duncan Stewart</h3>
        <p>Microgeneration is here and Electric Ireland is supporting customers on their low-carbon journey. Architect and environmentalist Duncan Stewart speaks to Electric Ireland about the small changes we can all make that will have a big impact.</p>
                <a class="btn btn-primary btn-medium" href="/residential/news/detail/duncan-stewart-on-the-small-changes-we-can-all-make-that-will-have-a-big-impact" aria-label="Learn more about Duncan Stewart">

        <h3>Aoife Gallagher</h3>
        <p>Aoife Gallagher is Electric Ireland’s Microgeneration Product Manager, and as an energy engineer is best-placed to answer some of your frequently asked questions around microgeneration.</p>
                <a class="btn btn-primary btn-medium" href="/residential/news/detail/electric-ireland-and-microgeneration--our-expert-answers-your-questions">

<section data-sf-element="Section">
    <div id="Contentplaceholder1_C032_Col00" class="sf_colsIn container" data-sf-element="Container" data-placeholder-label="Container">
<div class="content-block">
    <h2 style="text-align: center">Frequently asked questions</h2>
</div>



<div class="col-sm-8 offset-sm-2">
    <div class="accordion" id="acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-32478a81-d0a4-4594-af8e-059f3462d8dd">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-32478a81-d0a4-4594-af8e-059f3462d8dd" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-32478a81-d0a4-4594-af8e-059f3462d8dd">
                        What rate will I be paid?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-32478a81-d0a4-4594-af8e-059f3462d8dd" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-32478a81-d0a4-4594-af8e-059f3462d8dd" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Electric Ireland’s current Microgen Export rate is 19.5c per kWh. This rate is variable and subject to change. We estimate that customer export payments will range between €50-€300 per year, depending on the size and type of your microgeneration system (a typical installation of 10 panels would be about €150 per year).</p><p></p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-ac69f30e-ab8e-42a2-b968-3c031c2f7f48">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-ac69f30e-ab8e-42a2-b968-3c031c2f7f48" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-ac69f30e-ab8e-42a2-b968-3c031c2f7f48">
                        When will my payment start?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-ac69f30e-ab8e-42a2-b968-3c031c2f7f48" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-ac69f30e-ab8e-42a2-b968-3c031c2f7f48" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>On receipt of the NC6 form, ESB Networks will set up your export account. </p><p>Electric Ireland will receive your export data from ESB Networks, and you will then receive a microgeneration credit on each bill thereafter in line with your billing cycle.</p><p></p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-c7b57db0-ec15-4f70-bdb6-f9c95145bfc5">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-c7b57db0-ec15-4f70-bdb6-f9c95145bfc5" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-c7b57db0-ec15-4f70-bdb6-f9c95145bfc5">
                        Do I need a smart meter to avail of microgeneration?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-c7b57db0-ec15-4f70-bdb6-f9c95145bfc5" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-c7b57db0-ec15-4f70-bdb6-f9c95145bfc5" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>In line with guidelines provided by CRU (Commission for Regulation of Utilities), a smart meter is required to avail of The Microgeneration Support Scheme. To date, as part of the national meter upgrade programme, ESB Networks have been replacing standard 24-hour electricity meters with smart meters. From September 2023, ESB Networks will begin replacing day/night meters with smart meters.<br><br>Smart meters can measure the profile of demand at your home and thereby allow you to maximise your self-consumption. Smart meters can also measure the export of microgeneration installations to facilitate access to remuneration for residual electricity exported to the grid.<br><br>If you have a microgenerator installed, such as solar PV, your installer will submit the required NC6 connection form to ESB Networks on your behalf. This form will inform us at Electric Ireland that you have a registered microgeneration device and  <a href="https://www.esbnetworks.ie/services/get-connected/generator-connection" data-sf-ec-immutable="" data-sf-marked="">ESB Networks </a>will install a smart meter for you if you do not already have one.<br><br>If, for technical reasons, you cannot have a smart meter installed in your home, Electric Ireland will contact you to discuss.<br><br>If you choose to decline a smart meter, unfortunately you will not be eligible to avail of The Microgeneration Support Scheme, this is in line with CRU guidelines. For more information on the benefits of smart meters, visit our  <a href="/residential/products/smart-meters">smart meters FAQs </a>.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-b6715cf2-ef06-4aa9-8306-51e774300f34">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-b6715cf2-ef06-4aa9-8306-51e774300f34" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-b6715cf2-ef06-4aa9-8306-51e774300f34">
                        How does microgeneration work?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-b6715cf2-ef06-4aa9-8306-51e774300f34" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-b6715cf2-ef06-4aa9-8306-51e774300f34" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Microgenerators generate clean, renewable energy to meet some or all of the electricity demands of a household or business. When coupled with a diverter, this renewable energy can heat a water tank.</p><p>The Government Microgeneration Support Scheme is now available so that those with a registered microgeneration device can sell any excess electricity back to Ireland’s electricity grid.</p><p>This will help households reduce their carbon footprint and save money.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-2cab416e-749e-4169-87b1-37297060e5ba">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-2cab416e-749e-4169-87b1-37297060e5ba" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-2cab416e-749e-4169-87b1-37297060e5ba">
                        Who is eligible for the Microgeneration Support Scheme?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-2cab416e-749e-4169-87b1-37297060e5ba" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-2cab416e-749e-4169-87b1-37297060e5ba" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Electric Ireland customers that have a microgenerator installed such as solar PV, micro-wind, micro-hydro or renewable micro-CHP.</p><p>You must have notified ESB Networks via an NC6 form of your export grid connection.</p><p>Eligible customers will need a smart meter installed to be paid for Microgeneration export. Where customers eligible customer have not yet been offered a Smart meter, ESB Networks will endeavour to install a smart meter within four months of a valid <a href="https://www.esbnetworks.ie/docs/default-source/publications/6-e02835310-esb-nc-form_dec_22_nc6_final-v.pdf?sfvrsn=e5b30164_18" target="_blank"><strong>NC6 form</strong></a> being processed by ESB Networks. </p><p>If you're not eligible to have a smart meter installed, then you'll be paid a deemed export calculation.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-98ec530a-36d6-4199-995a-df19375ade65">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-98ec530a-36d6-4199-995a-df19375ade65" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-98ec530a-36d6-4199-995a-df19375ade65">
                        What is the Clean Export Guarantee?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-98ec530a-36d6-4199-995a-df19375ade65" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-98ec530a-36d6-4199-995a-df19375ade65" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>The Clean Export Guarantee (CEG) is the payment households will receive when they sell their excess electricity back to the national grid.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-13f946e2-4f45-45f3-9ec5-cc9e5623fc40">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-13f946e2-4f45-45f3-9ec5-cc9e5623fc40" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-13f946e2-4f45-45f3-9ec5-cc9e5623fc40">
                        I'm on a day/night tariff, can I avail of microgeneration?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-13f946e2-4f45-45f3-9ec5-cc9e5623fc40" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-13f946e2-4f45-45f3-9ec5-cc9e5623fc40" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>From September 2023, ESB Networks will begin replacing day/night meters with smart meters.<br><br>Smart meters can measure the profile of demand at your home and thereby allow you to maximise your self-consumption. Smart meters can also measure the export of microgeneration installations to facilitate access to remuneration for residual electricity exported to the grid.<br><br>If you have a microgenerator installed, such as solar PV, your installer will submit the required NC6 connection form to ESB Networks on your behalf. This form will let us at Electric Ireland know that you have a registered microgeneration device and  <a href="https://www.esbnetworks.ie/services/get-connected/generator-connection" data-sf-ec-immutable="" data-sf-marked="">ESB Networks </a>will install a smart meter for you.<br><br>If you are an existing Microgeneration customer with a day/night meter, you will continue to receive your deemed estimate Microgen credit on your bill until your smart meter is installed.<br><br>If you currently have a day/night meter and become a microgeneration customer after the 11th of September 2023, your microgeneration credit will begin after your smart meter is installed.<br><br>If, for technical reasons, you cannot have a smart meter installed in your home, Electric Ireland will contact you to discuss.<br><br>If you choose to decline a smart meter, unfortunately you will not be eligible to avail of The Microgeneration Support Scheme after the 11th of September 2023, meaning your microgeneration credits will cease at this time, this is in line with CRU guidelines. For more information on the benefits of smart meters, visit our  <a href="/residential/products/smart-meters">smart meters FAQs</a>.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-b73d2e2e-a1d7-44b3-870d-b6f0eb9e8e8e">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-b73d2e2e-a1d7-44b3-870d-b6f0eb9e8e8e" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-b73d2e2e-a1d7-44b3-870d-b6f0eb9e8e8e">
                        I am not an Electric Ireland customer, can I still avail of the Microgeneration Scheme?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-b73d2e2e-a1d7-44b3-870d-b6f0eb9e8e8e" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-b73d2e2e-a1d7-44b3-870d-b6f0eb9e8e8e" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Only Electric Ireland customers who meet the criteria above are eligible for the Microgeneration Scheme through Electric Ireland. <a href="https://www.electricireland.ie/switch/new-customer/price-plans?priceType=E" title="" target="" data-sf-ec-immutable="">Sign up to Electric Ireland</a>.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-f10b805e-c669-4cb2-aad3-ccfbfdd0e5d9">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-f10b805e-c669-4cb2-aad3-ccfbfdd0e5d9" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-f10b805e-c669-4cb2-aad3-ccfbfdd0e5d9">
                        What is solar PV?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-f10b805e-c669-4cb2-aad3-ccfbfdd0e5d9" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-f10b805e-c669-4cb2-aad3-ccfbfdd0e5d9" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Solar PV panels use the sun's energy to convert daylight into renewable energy. The electricity is then consumed within the home, reducing your need to buy energy from a supplier. When a Solar PV system produces more energy than a home needs, the extra energy can go to your immersion heater. Solar PV is not to be confused with</p><p>Solar Thermal - while Solar Thermal heats water only, Solar PV gives you free electricity and hot water.</p><p>Most customers install solar PV on their roof, however they can be installed anywhere on your property where there is sufficient open space and good sun exposure.</p><p>Electric Ireland can provide customers with solar PV through our preferred partners, NRG Panel. Our specialist teams will help you apply for <a href="https://www.seai.ie/grants/home-energy-grants/solar-electricity-grant/" title="" target="_blank" data-sf-ec-immutable="">solar PV grants</a> from the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland (SEAI).</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">
                <h2 class="accordion-header" id="heading-3be8e343-a08e-4664-bd11-e83f1a7a300d">
                    <button type="button" class="accordion-button collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse-3be8e343-a08e-4664-bd11-e83f1a7a300d" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-3be8e343-a08e-4664-bd11-e83f1a7a300d">
                        What happens if I switch to another electricity provider after registering for microgeneration with Electric Ireland?
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-3be8e343-a08e-4664-bd11-e83f1a7a300d" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-3be8e343-a08e-4664-bd11-e83f1a7a300d" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>At the end of this year you will be paid by Electric Ireland for the period up to switching to another supplier and your new supplier will advise on how they will make the payment for the next period.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="accordion-item">

                        I have solar PV installed but I don’t know the status of my NC6 or NC5 form.
                    </button>
                </h2>
                <div id="collapse-978e2722-90d1-4a1d-9cec-78693d2666a6" class="accordion-collapse collapse" aria-labelledby="heading-978e2722-90d1-4a1d-9cec-78693d2666a6" data-bs-parent="#acc-b7ee0df6-a63a-4e46-b7b9-ec4bd97c36f1">
                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>It’s likely that your PV installer submitted an NC6 or NC5 form on your behalf. Once the form is processed we are made aware that you have a microgeneration system at your property. We recently contacted all of our customers who we know to have microgeneration. If you did not hear from us it's possible that an NC5 or NC6 form has not been submitted for your microgenerator and you will need to contact your installer or ESB Networks for advice.</p>

                </h2>

                    <div class="accordion-body">
                        <p>Your first payment will be a backdated payment made in the form of a credit on your electricity bill at the end of 2022. Thereafter a credit will be applied on each bill reflecting your microgeneration export in that period.</p>

<script>
    let roiModal, niModal, geoLocationResponse;
    window.onload = () => {
        checkLocation();
    }
    const checkLocation = () => {
        if (optanonCategoryEnabled("OptanonConsent", "C0004")) {
            roiModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('roiModal'), options);
            niModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('niModal'), options);
            //If both cookies are undefined execute look up
            if (typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined");
            {
                GetToken().then(data => {
                    geoLocationResponse = data;
                    var result = geoLocationResponse.match(/GB/) || geoLocationResponse.match(/IE/);
                    var url = location.href;

                    if (url.indexOf(".com") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "IE") {
                        delCookie('NI');
                        roiModal.show();

                    } else if (url.indexOf(".ie") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "GB") {
                        delCookie('ROI');
                        niModal.show();
                    }
                    else if (result != "IE" && result != "GB") {
                        setCookie('outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt', 1, 30);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    const stayInSiteLocation = (loc) => {
        let msg = "NI";
        if (loc == "ROI") msg = "ROI";
        setCookie(msg + '-customer-region-prompt', 1, 180);
        loc == "ROI" ? roiModal.hide() : niModal.hide();
    }
    async function GetToken() {
    let myPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        fetch('/api/regional-prompt-token')
            .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Network response was not ok ' + response.statusText);
                }
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                resolve(data.Token);
            })
            .catch(error => {
            });
        });
        return await myPromise;
    }
</script>

We would also like to use additional cookies to analyse how you use our website, and to deliver personalised content and advertising. You can enable these additional cookies by selecting “Save Settings” or disable them by selecting “Reject All”.
You can learn more about and enable specific cookie categories by clicking on each of the different category headings. If you have opted to enable some but not all cookies, be sure to select “Save Settings” before exiting “Cookie Settings”.
Please note, disabling some or all additional cookie categories may impact your experience of our website and the services we are able to offer you.
You can adjust your cookie preferences at any time via “Cookie Settings” linked below within our website’s footer.
Find more information by visiting the cookie policy on our website.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.
Cookies Details
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
Off
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
Off
Functional cookies allow this website to remember choices you make and any customisations you make to website pages during your visit and provide enhanced, more personal features. For instance, these cookies can be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts and other parts of web pages that you can have changed. They may also be used to provide services you have asked for such as watching a video or commenting on a blog. The information these cookies collect cannot track your browsing activity on other websites. More information about such cookies can be found in the relevant third-party website.

Targeting & Advertising Cookies
Targeting & Advertising Cookies
Off
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

<script>
    let roiModal, niModal, geoLocationResponse;
    window.onload = () => {
        checkLocation();
    }
    const checkLocation = () => {
        if (optanonCategoryEnabled("OptanonConsent", "C0004")) {
            roiModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('roiModal'), options);
            niModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('niModal'), options);
            //If both cookies are undefined execute look up
            if (typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined");
            {
                GetToken().then(data => {
                    geoLocationResponse = data;
                    var result = geoLocationResponse.match(/GB/) || geoLocationResponse.match(/IE/);
                    var url = location.href;

                    if (url.indexOf(".com") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "IE") {
                        delCookie('NI');
                        roiModal.show();

                    } else if (url.indexOf(".ie") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "GB") {
                        delCookie('ROI');
                        niModal.show();
                    }
                    else if (result != "IE" && result != "GB") {
                        setCookie('outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt', 1, 30);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    const stayInSiteLocation = (loc) => {
        let msg = "NI";
        if (loc == "ROI") msg = "ROI";
        setCookie(msg + '-customer-region-prompt', 1, 180);
        loc == "ROI" ? roiModal.hide() : niModal.hide();
    }
    async function GetToken() {
    let myPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        fetch('/api/regional-prompt-token')
            .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Network response was not ok ' + response.statusText);
                }
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                resolve(data.Token);
            })
            .catch(error => {
            });
        });
        return await myPromise;
    }
</script>

Price Plans

How to Switch
Log out
Smart Meter
Smart Meters are the next generation of electricity meters being rolled out across Ireland. If you submit your own readings or a meter reader calls to your house to take your meter read, then you do not have a Smart Meter. If you are unsure if you have had a smart meter installed, don’t worry, once you input your MPRN we will advise you if you are able to avail of a smart price plan.
Unit Rate discount
The discount is applied to your electricity and gas unit prices.
First Year Cost
The First Year Cost represents the Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) after the welcome bonus is applied.
Advanced Electricity insights
Projected usage charts to keep your costs on track, similar homes analysis to guide you to reduce energy usage, personalised energy saving tips to help you use less, monthly electricity bill on a date of your choice, no more estimated electricity bills or bill surprises.
Free Electricity
Choose either Saturday or Sunday for free electricity, applied to your usage between 08:00 - 23:00 on that day.

Find more information by visiting the cookie policy on our website.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.

Performance Cookies
Off
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Functional Cookies
Off

For instance, these cookies can be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts and other parts of web pages that you can have changed. They may also be used to provide services you have asked for such as watching a video or commenting on a blog. <script>
    let roiModal, niModal, geoLocationResponse;
    window.onload = () => {
        checkLocation();
    }
    const checkLocation = () => {
        if (optanonCategoryEnabled("OptanonConsent", "C0004")) {
            roiModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('roiModal'), options);
            niModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('niModal'), options);
            //If both cookies are undefined execute look up
            if (typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined");
            {
                GetToken().then(data => {
                    geoLocationResponse = data;
                    var result = geoLocationResponse.match(/GB/) || geoLocationResponse.match(/IE/);
                    var url = location.href;

                    if (url.indexOf(".com") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "IE") {
                        delCookie('NI');
                        roiModal.show();

                    } else if (url.indexOf(".ie") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "GB") {
                        delCookie('ROI');
                        niModal.show();
                    }
                    else if (result != "IE" && result != "GB") {
                        setCookie('outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt', 1, 30);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    const stayInSiteLocation = (loc) => {
        let msg = "NI";
        if (loc == "ROI") msg = "ROI";
        setCookie(msg + '-customer-region-prompt', 1, 180);
        loc == "ROI" ? roiModal.hide() : niModal.hide();
    }
    async function GetToken() {
    let myPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        fetch('/api/regional-prompt-token')
            .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Network response was not ok ' + response.statusText);
                }
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                resolve(data.Token);
            })
            .catch(error => {
            });
        });
        return await myPromise;
    }
</script>

Our website uses cookies and other similar technologies which are strictly necessary for it to function. These are enabled by default and cannot be disabled.
We would also like to use additional cookies to analyse how you use our website, and to deliver personalised content and advertising. You can enable these additional cookies by selecting “Save Settings” or disable them by selecting “Reject All”.
You can learn more about and enable specific cookie categories by clicking on each of the different category headings. If you have opted to enable some but not all cookies, be sure to select “Save Settings” before exiting “Cookie Settings”.
Please note, disabling some or all additional cookie categories may impact your experience of our website and the services we are able to offer you.
You can adjust your cookie preferences at any time via “Cookie Settings” linked below within our website’s footer.
Find more information by visiting the cookie policy on our website.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.

Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
Off
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Functional cookies allow this website to remember choices you make and any customisations you make to website pages during your visit and provide enhanced, more personal features. For instance, these cookies can be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts and other parts of web pages that you can have changed. They may also be used to provide services you have asked for such as watching a video or commenting on a blog. The information these cookies collect cannot track your browsing activity on other websites. More information about such cookies can be found in the relevant third-party website.

They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. Smart Meter
Smart Meters are the next generation of electricity meters being rolled out across Ireland. If you submit your own readings or a meter reader calls to your house to take your meter read, then you do not have a Smart Meter. If you are unsure if you have had a smart meter installed, don’t worry, once you input your MPRN we will advise you if you are able to avail of a smart price plan.
Unit Rate discount
The discount is applied to your electricity and gas unit prices.
First Year Cost
The First Year Cost represents the Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) after the welcome bonus is applied.
Advanced Electricity insights
Projected usage charts to keep your costs on track, similar homes analysis to guide you to reduce energy usage, personalised energy saving tips to help you use less, monthly electricity bill on a date of your choice, no more estimated electricity bills or bill surprises.

Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.

Cookie Settings Overview
Our website uses cookies and other similar technologies which are strictly necessary for it to function. These are enabled by default and cannot be disabled.
We would also like to use additional cookies to analyse how you use our website, and to deliver personalised content and advertising. You can enable these additional cookies by selecting “Save Settings” or disable them by selecting “Reject All”.
You can learn more about and enable specific cookie categories by clicking on each of the different category headings. If you have opted to enable some but not all cookies, be sure to select “Save Settings” before exiting “Cookie Settings”.
Please note, disabling some or all additional cookie categories may impact your experience of our website and the services we are able to offer you.
You can adjust your cookie preferences at any time via “Cookie Settings” linked below within our website’s footer.
Find more information by visiting the cookie policy on our website.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.
Cookies Details
Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
Off
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Cookies Details
Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
Off
Functional cookies allow this website to remember choices you make and any customisations you make to website pages during your visit and provide enhanced, more personal features. For instance, these cookies can be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts and other parts of web pages that you can have changed. They may also be used to provide services you have asked for such as watching a video or commenting on a blog. The information these cookies collect cannot track your browsing activity on other websites. More information about such cookies can be found in the relevant third-party website.
Cookies Details
Targeting & Advertising Cookies
Targeting & Advertising Cookies
Off
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Electric Ireland Dual Fuel
Substantiation
The proposed savings of up to €791 is based on the difference between the Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) of our 28% discounted product €2562.44 and the EAB of our standard variable tariff €3353.54. The difference being the saving of €791.10. Prices are correct as of 1st of May 2024.

Substantiation

DUAL FUEL PRICING TERMS & CONDITIONS
Electric Ireland Dual ValueSaver price plan (Fixed Term) incl. NightSaver
Product Terms and Conditions
You must hold an electricity and gas account with Electric Ireland for a minimum of 12 months from date of sign up to avail of this price plan.
If you cease to take electricity and gas from Electric Ireland before the end of your electricity price plan, we will apply a €50 (incl. VAT) exit fee to your electricity or gas account.
After the end of your fixed term, the exit fee clause will cease to apply to your contract. Your savings will continue for as long as you remain a customer of Electric Ireland and continue with Savings conditions.
Electricity and Gas price plan standard unit rates and standing charges may be subject to change, this will not affect your price plan savings percentage.
The ValueSaver Gas price plan is for customers with usage less than 73,000kWh per annum (on bands A, B and C as advised by Gas Networks Ireland). Where you have usage greater than 73,000kWh as advised to us by Gas Networks Ireland, then you will be put on the ValueSaver Large Gas price plan.
These price plan Terms and Conditions are in addition to the Electric Ireland General Terms and Conditions for Residential Customers.
Electric Ireland reserves the right to vary and/or cancel this offer at any time for valid commercial, technical, operational and/or regulatory reasons.
Dual Fuel Savings
A 3% saving (variable after 12 months) is applied to the Electricity price plan standard unit rate and Gas price plan standard unit rate.
To avail of the Dual Fuel Savings, you must continue to hold an electricity and gas account.
If you discontinue your electricity or gas account, Electric Ireland have the right to remove the Dual Fuel Savings.
Direct Debit Savings
A 5% saving (variable after 12 months) is applied to the Electricity price plan standard unit rate and Gas price plan standard unit rate.
To avail of the Direct Debit Savings, payment by direct debit is mandatory.
If you discontinue paying by direct debit for any reason, Electric Ireland have the right to remove the Direct Debit Savings.
Non-Direct Debit Pay on Time Savings
A 4% saving (variable after 12 months) is applied to the Electricity price plan standard unit rate and Gas price plan standard unit rate.
Only available for customers who do not pay by direct debit and are not already availing of the Direct Debit Savings.
Your electricity and gas account must be kept up-to-date and all bills must be paid within credit terms.
If you do not keep your electricity and/or gas account up-to-date and pay within credit terms, Electric Ireland reserves the right to remove the Pay on Time Savings.
Online Billing Savings (or Ebill Savings)
An additional 0.5% Online Billing unit rate reduction is applied to the standard unit rate of the Electricity price plan and to the standard unit rate of the Gas price plan.
If you opt for Online Billing it is mandatory to have Online Billing on both your electricity and gas price plans.
We will register you for Online Billing.
You will receive notification by email to confirm online registration.
Email notification will be sent when your bill is ready to view online.
If you de-register from Online Billing, savings offered for Online Billing will be withdrawn.
Switching Bonus
If you receive a Switching Bonus you must remain a customer for a minimum of 12 months.
The Switching Bonus can only be used to offset charges on your Electric Ireland account. NO CASH ALTERNATIVES OR REFUNDS will be offered.
If you receive a Switching Bonus and cease to take electricity and/or gas from Electric Ireland before the end of your Dual Fuel price plan term, Electric Ireland reserves the right to cancel the Switching Bonus and debit your account with an amount up to the value of the Switching Bonus.
Only one application of credit per person in a twelve month period. Entries on behalf of another person will not be accepted. Applications in the joint names of two or more persons qualify for one allocation of Switching Bonus offer.
The Switching Bonus value is inclusive of VAT.
These Switching Bonus Terms and Conditions are in addition to the Electric Ireland
Customer Offer Terms and Conditions
for Residential Customers.
Effective Rates
We quote the unit rate inclusive of your savings for information purposes only. The unit rate displayed on your bill will be the standard unit rate before savings. You will see your savings total as a separate line item on the bill
Low User Standing Charge
Only applicable to customers who use on average 2kWh or less of electricity per day, equivalent to 122kWh for an average billing cycle of 61 days. The Low User Standing Charge does not apply to customers in receipt of a Free Electricity Allowance.
Supply Point Capacity
A charge is payable in order to move gas through the pipelines. This charge is essentially where gas suppliers reserve space on the gas pipeline on behalf of their customers for the coming gas year. The amount of space reserved is called Supply Point Capacity (SPC). Each gas point has an individual, site specific SPC. This capacity for Non Daily Metered Customers is an estimation of peak day consumption measured in kWh. The estimation methodology is based on the FAR process and has been approved by the Commission for Regulation of Utilities (CRU). Gas Networks Ireland is responsible for estimating SPC for all customers. For a fuller explanation of SPC please visit
gas networks.

    <div><h2 style="color: rgba(51, 51, 51, 1)"><strong>DUAL FUEL PRICING TERMS & CONDITIONS</strong></h2><a name="DVS" data-sf-ec-immutable=""></a><h2>Electric Ireland Dual ValueSaver price plan (Fixed Term) incl. NightSaver</h2><p> </p><h3>Product Terms and Conditions</h3><ul><li>You must hold an electricity and gas account with Electric Ireland for a minimum of 12 months from date of sign up to avail of this price plan.</li><li>If you cease to take electricity and gas from Electric Ireland before the end of your electricity price plan, we will apply a €50 (incl. VAT) exit fee to your electricity or gas account.</li><li>After the end of your fixed term, the exit fee clause will cease to apply to your contract. Your savings will continue for as long as you remain a customer of Electric Ireland and continue with Savings conditions.</li><li>Electricity and Gas price plan standard unit rates and standing charges may be subject to change, this will not affect your price plan savings percentage.</li><li>The ValueSaver Gas price plan is for customers with usage less than 73,000kWh per annum (on bands A, B and C as advised by Gas Networks Ireland). Where you have usage greater than 73,000kWh as advised to us by Gas Networks Ireland, then you will be put on the ValueSaver Large Gas price plan.</li><li>These price plan Terms and Conditions are in addition to the Electric Ireland General Terms and Conditions for Residential Customers.</li><li>Electric Ireland reserves the right to vary and/or cancel this offer at any time for valid commercial, technical, operational and/or regulatory reasons.</li></ul><h4>Dual Fuel Savings</h4><ul><li>A 3% saving (variable after 12 months) is applied to the Electricity price plan standard unit rate and Gas price plan standard unit rate.</li><li>To avail of the Dual Fuel Savings, you must continue to hold an electricity and gas account.</li><li>If you discontinue your electricity or gas account, Electric Ireland have the right to remove the Dual Fuel Savings.</li></ul><h4>Direct Debit Savings</h4><ul><li>A 5% saving (variable after 12 months) is applied to the Electricity price plan standard unit rate and Gas price plan standard unit rate.</li><li>To avail of the Direct Debit Savings, payment by direct debit is mandatory.</li><li>If you discontinue paying by direct debit for any reason, Electric Ireland have the right to remove the Direct Debit Savings.</li></ul><h4>Non-Direct Debit Pay on Time Savings</h4><ul><li>A 4% saving (variable after 12 months) is applied to the Electricity price plan standard unit rate and Gas price plan standard unit rate.</li><li>Only available for customers who do not pay by direct debit and are not already availing of the Direct Debit Savings.</li><li>Your electricity and gas account must be kept up-to-date and all bills must be paid within credit terms.</li><li>If you do not keep your electricity and/or gas account up-to-date and pay within credit terms, Electric Ireland reserves the right to remove the Pay on Time Savings.</li></ul><h4>Online Billing Savings (or Ebill Savings)</h4><ul><li>An additional 0.5% Online Billing unit rate reduction is applied to the standard unit rate of the Electricity price plan and to the standard unit rate of the Gas price plan.</li><li>If you opt for Online Billing it is mandatory to have Online Billing on both your electricity and gas price plans.</li><li>We will register you for Online Billing.</li><li>You will receive notification by email to confirm online registration.</li><li>Email notification will be sent when your bill is ready to view online.</li><li>If you de-register from Online Billing, savings offered for Online Billing will be withdrawn.</li></ul><h4>Switching Bonus</h4><ul><li>If you receive a Switching Bonus you must remain a customer for a minimum of 12 months.</li><li>The Switching Bonus can only be used to offset charges on your Electric Ireland account. NO CASH ALTERNATIVES OR REFUNDS will be offered.</li><li>If you receive a Switching Bonus and cease to take electricity and/or gas from Electric Ireland before the end of your Dual Fuel price plan term, Electric Ireland reserves the right to cancel the Switching Bonus and debit your account with an amount up to the value of the Switching Bonus.</li><li>Only one application of credit per person in a twelve month period. Entries on behalf of another person will not be accepted. <script>
    let roiModal, niModal, geoLocationResponse;
    window.onload = () => {
        checkLocation();
    }
    const checkLocation = () => {
        if (optanonCategoryEnabled("OptanonConsent", "C0004")) {
            roiModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('roiModal'), options);
            niModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('niModal'), options);
            //If both cookies are undefined execute look up
            if (typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && typeof getCookieLoc("outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined");
            {
                GetToken().then(data => {
                    geoLocationResponse = data;
                    var result = geoLocationResponse.match(/GB/) || geoLocationResponse.match(/IE/);
                    var url = location.href;

                    if (url.indexOf(".com") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("ROI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "IE") {
                        delCookie('NI');
                        roiModal.show();

                    } else if (url.indexOf(".ie") > -1 && typeof getCookieLoc("NI-customer-region-prompt") === "undefined" && result == "GB") {
                        delCookie('ROI');
                        niModal.show();
                    }
                    else if (result != "IE" && result != "GB") {
                        setCookie('outside-ireland-customer-region-prompt', 1, 30);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }
    const stayInSiteLocation = (loc) => {
        let msg = "NI";
        if (loc == "ROI") msg = "ROI";
        setCookie(msg + '-customer-region-prompt', 1, 180);
        loc == "ROI" ? roiModal.hide() : niModal.hide();
    }
    async function GetToken() {
    let myPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        fetch('/api/regional-prompt-token')
            .then(response => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Network response was not ok ' + response.statusText);
                }
                return response.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                resolve(data.Token);
            })
            .catch(error => {
            });
        });
        return await myPromise;
    }
</script>

How to Switch

Smart Meter
Smart Meters are the next generation of electricity meters being rolled out across Ireland. If you submit your own readings or a meter reader calls to your house to take your meter read, then you do not have a Smart Meter. If you are unsure if you have had a smart meter installed, don’t worry, once you input your MPRN we will advise you if you are able to avail of a smart price plan.
Unit Rate discount
The discount is applied to your electricity and gas unit prices.
First Year Cost
The First Year Cost represents the Estimated Annual Bill (EAB) after the welcome bonus is applied.
Advanced Electricity insights
Projected usage charts to keep your costs on track, similar homes analysis to guide you to reduce energy usage, personalised energy saving tips to help you use less, monthly electricity bill on a date of your choice, no more estimated electricity bills or bill surprises.
Free Electricity
Choose either Saturday or Sunday for free electricity, applied to your usage between 08:00 - 23:00 on that day.

<script async="">

  var SettingsLocal = {
    PricePlanCharges: '/switch/new-customer/priceplan-charges',
    };

    function showPricePlanCharges(pricePlanId) {
    $("#nav_top_div").css("display", "none");
    $.ajax({
      url: SettingsLocal.PricePlanCharges,
      type: 'GET',
      cache: true,
      data: {
        'pricePlanId': pricePlanId
      },
      dataType: "html",
        success: function (data) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          $('#divPricePlanCharges').html(data);
            $('#dialogPricePlanCharges').modal('show');

          // Give focus to last active element when modal is closed
          var activeElement = document.activeElement;

            $('#dialogPricePlanCharges').on('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
                $("#nav_top_div").css("display", "block");
                $('body').removeAttr("style")

            $(activeElement).focus();
            });

          disableModalTab();
        }, 0);

        return false;
      },
    });
  }
</script>
